station.name: Songbuk-dong
station.provider: Gyeonggi Institute of Health and Environment

quality.qaStatus: Provincial raw hourly observations; may differ from national final-confirmed data. Original dataDt labels 00–23 are preserved; the provincial page displays them as 01–24. August capture is 51.478%, with a 341-hour missing run; summer still passes the 75% seasonal rule. The source reports 644 numeric zeros, including a 39-hour run; these are retained and have no per-reading QA flags or detection-limit metadata.
quality.ratificationStatus: Raw provincial measurements; no NIER final-ratification claim.
quality.missingTreatment: Missing source tokens, nonfinite/nonnumeric/negative readings and unavailable UTC boundary hours are null. Numeric zero retained; no interpolation or imputation.
quality.license: Unrestricted reuse (이용허락범위 제한 없음), specified for Gyeonggi's 1-hour concentration product in official DATA.GO.KR catalog 15122939.
quality.licenseBasis: The official catalog identifies Gyeonggi Institute of Health and Environment as producer of the province's raw 1-hour station-concentration product and explicitly permits unrestricted reuse. These responses are independently acquired from that institute's public station-query interface for the same hourly concentration product. This is a product-level catalog attribution, not a blanket license inferred from the website footer.
quality.spatialScope: One urban-air monitor, Songbuk-dong, Pyeongtaek; not a citywide average.

documentedMaintenance.reason: Station operation stopped after cooling-system failure

quality.selectionReason: Identified Pyeongtaek urban monitor with at least 75% valid hours in the year and each meteorological season; no concentration-based selection.

timeConvention.hour_interval_semantics: Original provincial JSON dataDt labels 00–23 are preserved without a one-hour shift. The province's public page adds one to display those observations as hours 01–24.
timeConvention.utc_conversion: Subtract nine hours from each original dataDt local label. No daylight-saving time in Seoul/Pyeongtaek in 2024.
timeConvention.interpretation_limit: The public page exposes the display's +1-hour convention, but a separate physical interval-start/end dictionary was not located. Data are grouped using the source's original 00–23 day labels, preserving each source day's 24 observations.
timeConvention.utc_boundary: Original local-year first nine hours precede UTC2024; the final nine UTC2024 hours need the following local year's data and remain null.
